Transformation 2 (Page 22) The next step is the third step, rune recasting. The rune map of the Wanxiang Senluo Meditation Method unfolds in the consciousness. There are a full set of thirty-six runes, and the structure of each one is more than ten times more complex than those he condensed using the low-level meditation method before. The order of the runes, the energy resonance method, and the flow path of spiritual power are all completely different from the old system. He needs to use the high-level meditation method to convert the runes that have already been condensed. The old runes imprinted with the new frequency were all recast. The consciousness sank into the spiritual sea again. The first rune was suspended in the mist, and its emerald green light had returned to stability. Its structural frame was still old, and the impurities inside were clearly visible. The scratches on the surface of the runes were rough, and there were fine burrs on the edges. Runes of this quality were already considered high-quality in the Wanxiang Senluo Meditation Method. Ethan began to observe. Think of the rune corresponding to the Wanxiang Senluo Meditation Method. The rune visualization diagram of the advanced meditation method is unfolded in his consciousness. It is an extremely complex mental power structure, and the position, angle, and depth of each scratch are incredibly precise. His mental power rushed to the old rune and began to polish according to the requirements of the new visualization diagram. A rough scratch on the surface of the old rune was washed away by the mental power. Brushing, the rough edges were smoothed, and the depth of the scratches was recalibrated. The rune trembled slightly, and a very faint emerald green ripple appeared on the surface. Then the second and third runs were reshaped bit by bit under the guidance of the new visualization diagram. The impurities were removed, the scratches were calibrated, and the structural frame was gradually adjusted to the shape required by the advanced meditation method. It took Ethan a whole day to polish. When it was finished, the rune had completely changed. The surface was as smooth as jade, and the marks were as precise as a ruler. The emerald green light circulated inside the rune, and every time it flickered, it caused a faint ripple in the surrounding mist. After polishing the first one, he immediately started the second one. Then, all his attention was lost in the training room. All the energy is concentrated on the runes that are being reforged one by one. With each rune completed, there will be one more authentic rune in the spiritual sea, and the traces of the old runes will be reduced. By the seventh day, the scene in the spiritual sea is completely different. The nineteen new emerald green runes are suspended in the mist, and the light they emit is deep, three-dimensional, and almost substantive. Their arrangement has also changed. It is no longer the loose distribution of the old meditation method, but is arranged in a precise formation according to the map of the Wanxiang Senluo meditation method. The emerald green light begins to flow between the nineteen runes, and each flow will increase the stability of the spiritual sea. The old runes that are still waiting to be polished also begin to adjust their positions in this resonance, and actively move towards the new one. The formations moved closer. On the thirteenth day, Ethan finished polishing the thirty-sixth rune. The moment the last rune was recast, the thirty-six emerald green runes lit up at the same time. The thirty-six runes were arranged in a perfect formation, and each rune resonated with the other thirty-five. The emerald green light flowed between the runes and illuminated the gray mist.
